component.name: Fugue
component.summary: A native Linux client for BYOND games such as Space Station 13

description.p: Fugue is a native Linux client and launcher for BYOND games. It replaces DreamSeeker on servers that run stock BYOND, so games such as Space Station 13 can be played without a BYOND install and without Wine.

ul.li: A server list and sign-in with a BYOND account, or play as a guest
The game map, HUD, stat panel, verbs, sound and the HTML windows games use for their interfaces
A resource cache, so a second join to the same server downloads nothing

description.p: Fugue is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by BYOND.
Fixes the view from inside an opaque mech, which showed only your own tile and whatever opaque tiles touched it. The Flatpak now updates through its own repository.

Opens /vg/station's RCD and RPD windows with their icons, lists the verbs of carried and nearby objects in the verb tabs (the AI's camera zoom), applies /vg/station's dark mode to the whole window, draws a skin's own control colours, lays skins out exactly as DreamSeeker does (/vg/station, Baystation and tgstation), parses winset strings as DreamSeeker does, and shows input() list prompts as a list alone.

Adds an experimental GPU renderer, off until the pager's "Use GPU rendering" option turns it on. Sends typed verbs to the source DreamSeeker picks (/vg/station's Whisper), draws the AI's camera static, keeps round-end credits rolling through a reboot, and fixes right-click on equipped items, flick() on other z-levels, chained animate() timing, hover and secondary-map input, and odd characters in browse() windows.

Draws BYOND particles (/vg/station's airflow dust, steam, smoke) and turf vis_contents (ZAS gas), moves the view with client pixel offsets and animate(client), sends mouse-wheel events, carries glides into the next step as DreamSeeker does, starts a step from rest without delay, and adds text macros and a pager tray icon.
Native macOS and Windows builds now compile and pass their tests. Fixes a prompt-dialog crash on Windows and the JPEG decoder's error handling.

Stays connected when idle, reconnects as DreamSeeker does, matches DreamSeeker's key handling and verb prompts more closely, and fixes many /vg/station display issues. Native macOS and Windows builds.
